tool_args.rationale: The pilot varies u_now and s_grad together across only five observations, leaving genuine ambiguity about their joint effect. The open-branch probe is the available targeted measurement for resolving it.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the recalled siphon, Haldane, or Cobb–Douglas model directly
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five confounded observations do not distinguish these mechanisms or establish behavior on an unobserved branch.
The immediate uncertainty is branch identification, for which the cheaper discriminating probe is more targeted.
It is irrelevant to identifying the mechanism.
